streetquest:mack_description: A fixer running quiet errands from a borrowed city desk.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_intro_back_of: Back off. I'm not in the mood for company.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_intro_backsto:
Wasn't always like this. Had a job, a place, people who said they'd stick around. Then a few bad turns stacked up, and now this sidewalk is about all I've got left.

You look like you can still choose what kind of person you want to be. Could you do me a favor?
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_offer: If you're serious, then keep it simple. Could you get me a hotdog? I'm starving.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_active: Still hungry over here. Bring me a hotdog when you can.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_ready: That smells amazing. Hand over the hotdog and I'll pay you what I can.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_accept_manage: Thanks. Just one hotdog will do.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_complete_mana: You actually came back. Thanks. Here, take this for your trouble.
streetquest:dialog_main_q1_finished: You did right by me. That's all I've got for now, but people around the city talk. More work will find you.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_intro: Excuse me, please. Have you seen a little girl running around here? Brown hair, quick feet, zero sense of timing?
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_offer: It's my daughter Julia. We came into Ika Bohag for ten minutes and she decided this whole store is a hide-and-seek arena. Could you help me find her?
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_active: Julia has to be somewhere in Ika Bohag. She's probably giggling behind a couch right now.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_ready: You found Julia? Thank goodness. Did you tell her her mother is searching half the store for her?
streetquest:help_fran_q1_active: Find Julia inside Ika Bohag and tell her Fran is looking for her.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_accept_manage: Thank you. She's tiny, fast, and way too proud of herself when she's hiding.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_complete_mana: Oh, thank goodness. That's my Julia. Thank you for getting through to her before I turned this whole shop upside down. Here, take this, and let me give you my number too.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_finished: Julia is safe, and I owe you one. I finally get to breathe again.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_intro: Hey, it's Fran. I just wanted to thank you again for helping me find Julia. I don't think she realizes how much panic one tiny person can cause.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_offer: I'd really like to make it up to you properly. Why don't you come by for dinner sometime? It's the least I can do.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_active: Come by whenever you're ready. I've already told the front gate to let you through, so just head over when you have time.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_ready: I'm really glad you came by. Julia's still talking about it.
streetquest:help_fran_q2_active: Visit Fran for dinner. She arranged access to her apartment building.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_accept_manage: Perfect. I'll make something nice for us, and I'll let the front gate know you're welcome upstairs.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_complete_mana: Thanks again for coming over. It meant a lot to both of us.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q2_finished: Dinner still stands. You're always welcome to come by.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_julia_intro: Hihi, I'm the best at hide and seek. Mom still hasn't found me and I've been winning for ages.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_julia_confirm: Your mom is looking for you.
streetquest:dialog_fran_q1_julia_after: Aww, that means the game is over already? Fine... but tell her I was definitely the champion.
streetquest:dialog_generic_finished: I don't need anything from you right now.
